understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid, adjust the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation to match each goal cell, then step onto the matching goal. Complete every goal in every level to win.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement uses directional actions and consumes stamina. If stamina reaches zero, the next action costs a life and resets stamina. Shape modifiers cycle shape, color modifiers cycle color, and rotation modifiers rotate the piece 90° clockwise. A goal is completed only when shape, color, and rotation all match its requirements simultaneously; in this episode, the piece needed to reach the rotation changer at [19,30] to change from 270° to 0° before entering the goal at [34,10].
